question: Will Anthropic’s IPO S-1 be public by 16 October 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Anthropic’s Form S-1 registration statement for its proposed IPO becomes publicly accessible on the SEC’s EDGAR system by 23:59 New York time on 16 October 2026, inclusive.
A preliminary S-1 counts; final pricing and SEC approval are not required. Confidential submissions, leaked documents, and announcements or news reports without a publicly accessible S-1 on EDGAR do not count.
The IPO itself does not need to occur by the deadline. A subsequent postponement or cancellation does not reverse a qualifying YES. Otherwise, resolves NO.

# Research report 1 of 2


Note: my page fetches failed because the proxy refused the connections. Everything below comes from search-result summaries. I left out any material dated after 10 October 2026.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is SEC EDGAR full-text and company search for an Anthropic PBC Form S-1. I could not open EDGAR directly.
- 2026-10-03: An IPO tracker said an EDGAR search that day found no public Anthropic S-1. [themesetfs](https://themesetfs.com/insights/anthropic-ipo-what-is-known-and-what-remains-unconfirmed)
- 2026-10-01: Bloomberg-based coverage said no public prospectus existed yet. [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/01/report-anthropic-targets-pre-thanksgiving-ipo-launch-despite-warning-of-ais-existential-risks/embed/)
- I found no report of a public S-1 on or before 2026-10-10.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Anthropic's only known filing is the confidential draft registration statement from 2026-06-01. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-ipo-s1-prospectus.html), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-files-to-go-public/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-02: China Daily HK repeated the Bloomberg report of a mid-November listing target. [China Daily HK](https://www.chinadailyhk.com/article/640445)
- 2026-10-01: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic wants to go public as soon as mid-November, before Thanksgiving (26 November):
  - Formal marketing could start the week of 9 November, about a month later than the earlier mid-October plan.
  - The company still expects to list by year-end, but the schedule could change.
  - Anthropic has invited institutional investors to an investor day at its San Francisco headquarters on 14 October.
  - Prospective investors see $1.8T to $2T as a fair valuation.
  
  [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bgov.com/banking-law/anthropic-said-to-target-mega-ipo-before-thanksgiving-holiday), [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/01/report-anthropic-targets-pre-thanksgiving-ipo-launch-despite-warning-of-ais-existential-risks/embed/), [implicator.ai](https://www.implicator.ai/anthropic-could-start-ipo-roadshow-week-of-nov-9-putting-debut-before-thanksgiving/)
- 2026-09-18/19: The WSJ reported, as relayed by secondary sources, that the listing moved from October to November. The stated reason was that Anthropic wanted to show a strong third quarter first. [Digg](https://digg.com/ai/tu14otce), [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/anthropic-delays-ipo-to-november-amid-market-anticipation/), [hyper.ai](https://hyper.ai/en/stories/7c92cca0b743e35a5cd21c57f8cae9a9)
- 2026-09-05: Reuters reported that the IPO launch had shifted toward mid-October. The prospectus had been expected to go public as early as the following week, which did not happen. [CNBC/Reuters](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/anthropic-ipo-launch-shifts-toward-mid-october-reuters.html), [Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2627660/anthropic-delays-ipo-launch?amp=1)
- 2026-09-04: Bloomberg reported that Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Citi are leading the IPO. [Forge](https://forgeglobal.com/insights/anthropic-upcoming-ipo-news/)
- Early September: Reports expected the public prospectus "after Labor Day" or "after Sept 7". That timing slipped repeatedly. [you.com](https://for.you.com/posts/anthropic-set-to-reveal-ipo-prospectus-after-september-7-07932260)

## 4. Base rates
- Expected public-filing dates for Anthropic have already slipped at least twice: from early or mid-September to late September, and then to a November marketing window.
- For large confidential-filing IPOs, the public S-1 usually comes about 15 to 21 days before the roadshow. One analysis says recent IPOs took about three to four weeks from public S-1 to pricing. [Polymarket coverage](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a market titled "Will Anthropic's IPO S-1 be public by…". It may be this exact question, but I could not open it to see the price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/jim/will-anthropics-ipo-s1-be-public-by)
- Polymarket has markets on whether Anthropic completes an IPO by the end of 2026. Reported odds were 89% in June, then about 78%, then about 68%, depending on the article date. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-ipo-date-given-clear-timeframe-in-polymarket-odds), [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in)
- FutureSearch has a forecast page on Anthropic's IPO date. I did not see a value. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/on-what-date-will-anthropic-complete-its-ipo-i)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-14: Anthropic's investor day for institutional investors in San Francisco. A public flip could be timed near it, but no source said it would be.
- Mid-October: Q3 2026 results closing. The WSJ said Anthropic wanted to show a strong Q3 before marketing, which could push the public S-1 after Q3 numbers are ready to include.
- Rolling: Bloomberg, Reuters, WSJ or The Information reports on a specific public-filing date. So far, every report before 10 October points to marketing starting the week of 9 November.
- 2026-11-03: US midterm elections. These are after the deadline but affect the overall schedule.

Sources: the links listed above.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)


## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is SEC EDGAR, a full-text or company search for Anthropic, PBC. I couldn't query EDGAR live for the cutoff date.
- Searching EDGAR for "Anthropic" brings up unrelated filings, such as a Form D for an Anthropic-branded fund and an ETF filing. Check that any S-1 is from Anthropic, PBC itself. [finrep](https://www.finrep.ai/blog/anthropic-s-1-edgar-2026-what-finance-professionals-need-to-know)
- 2026-10-04: Forkast reported there was still no public Anthropic S-1 on EDGAR. EDGAR had shown no public Anthropic filing as of 26 September either. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The only filing so far is the confidential draft from June 1, and confidential filings don't count.
- 2026-06-01: Anthropic confirmed it had confidentially submitted a draft registration statement for a proposed IPO. [Yahoo/AP](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-confidentially-files-initial-public-163600968.html), [Michigan Public](https://www.michiganpublic.org/2026-06-01/ai-giant-anthropic-prepares-to-sell-stock-to-the-public-files-preliminary-ipo-paperwork)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-05: CNN reported the IPO could happen "as soon as November." [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/05/business/anthropic-ipo-stock-market)
- 2026-10-04: Forkast said it had been 126 days since the confidential filing with no public S-1. In its view, the missing filing is a "timing signal" pointing to November. It added that the public prospectus must be out at least 15 days before the roadshow. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)
- Around 2026-09-18/19: The WSJ, via secondhand reports, said the IPO moved from October to November so investors could see third-quarter results first. The quarter ended September 30. The reported target was a valuation of about $2T and a raise of up to $100B. [Digg summary](https://digg.com/ai/tu14otce), [hyper.ai](https://hyper.ai/en/stories/7c92cca0b743e35a5cd21c57f8cae9a9)
- 2026-09-05/06: Reuters reported marketing would start in mid-October with a listing just before the midterms. The public prospectus was no longer expected the following week but "not until late September," and was tied to finalizing a $15B revolving credit facility. That date passed without a filing. [Tribune India](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/business/anthropic-pushes-back-ipo-timeline-eyes-mid-october-launch/), [The Standard](https://www.thestandard.com.hk/world/article/341919/Anthropic-IPO-launch-shifts-toward-mid-October-sources-say)
- Late August 2026: Reuters had expected the public S-1 shortly after Labor Day. It didn't come, which makes it at least the second missed expected date. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/the-anthropic-s-1-that-was-expected-after-labor-day-still-hasnt-arrived/)

## 4. Base rates
- Public filing has to come at least 15 calendar days before the roadshow starts. Big tech IPOs usually make the S-1 public about 3 to 5 weeks before pricing. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)
- Anthropic's expected public-filing dates have repeatedly slipped: after Labor Day, then late September, then not by October 4. I found no dated, sourced estimate of when the S-1 itself would go public.
- Adding Q3 numbers (quarter ended September 30) to the S-1 could take several weeks after quarter-end. That leans against a filing in the first half of October, but I found no source confirming whether Q3 financials will be in the initial public S-1.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Action Network, undated, roughly late September or early October: Polymarket put about 68% on an Anthropic IPO before the end of 2026. On the date ladder, October was 39% and December 68%. The piece recommended buying No on the October listing at 62¢. It called a public S-1 "in the next two weeks" the main risk to that trade. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in), [Action Network 2](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-ipo-date-given-clear-timeframe-in-polymarket-odds)
- Another snapshot, undated: Polymarket at 54% for an IPO by November 30, 74% by December 15 and 79% by December 31. [Coingape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-anthropic-ipo-by-december-31-2026-odds-at-79/)
- Manifold has a market on when Anthropic's public S-1 will appear, plus a "which week" market. I couldn't load either to get current prices. [Manifold S-1](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropics-public-form-s1-appe), [Manifold week](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/which-week-will-anthropics-ipo-pros)

- A public S-1 on EDGAR, the only thing that resolves YES. Watch for Bloomberg or Reuters reports that it is "said to plan public filing" in the coming days, which usually come out 0 to 3 days ahead.
- Q3 close and any leaked Q3 revenue figures. Those would suggest financials are nearly ready to include.
- News on the $15B revolving credit facility closing, which Reuters linked to the next steps of the IPO process.
- Any market shock, or a decision to slip past the U.S. midterms (November 3), could delay things further.

forecasts.reasoning:
Evidence for Yes:
- The 14 October institutional investor day could be paired with a public flip.
- The roadshow week of 9 November leaves a filing window that opens around mid-October.
- The previous mid-October marketing plan implied a filing about now, and the documents are presumably near-final.

Evidence for No:
- Bloomberg on 1 October moved marketing to the week of 9 November.
- The WSJ on 18-19 September said the delay was to show Q3 results. The quarter ended 30 September, and reviewed Q3 numbers usually take more than about two weeks to prepare.
- Forkast on 4 October and themesetfs on 3 October confirmed there was no S-1.
- The company has a record of missing expected filing dates.
- No report as of 10 October says a public filing is imminent. Such reports usually appear 0-3 days ahead.

(e) No scenario: Anthropic holds the investor day under testing-the-waters rules, finishes the Q3 financials, and flips the S-1 public around 19-26 October, ahead of the 9 November roadshow.

Yes scenario: Anthropic files publicly on 13-16 October to coincide with the investor day. It uses Q2 financials plus a Q3 "recent developments" section, aiming for a longer public period before the roadshow given the deal's size.

(f) I start from about 20-25% for an early flip. The Q3 inclusion rationale and the record of slippage pull that down, while the investor day timing pulls it up slightly. I have no liquid market price for this exact question. I settle at about 17%.

Probability: 17%

for NO:
- On 18 and 19 September, the WSJ reported the IPO was delayed specifically to show Q3 results, and the quarter ended 30 September.
- Financial statements dated 30 June go stale under the SEC's 135-day rule around mid-November, so a late-November pricing effectively needs Q3 figures. Reviewed Q3 figures are hard to have ready within about two weeks of quarter-end.
- Bloomberg reported on 1 October that marketing starts the week of 9 November.
- Anthropic has repeatedly missed its expected filing dates.
- Investor days often use the confidential filing under testing-the-waters rules, so a public flip is not needed beforehand.

(e) NO scenario: the investor day on 14 October uses the confidential draft. Q3 numbers are finished, and the public S-1 lands around 20 to 26 October, roughly 15 days before the 9 November roadshow.

YES scenario: Anthropic flips the S-1 public on 14 to 16 October, around the investor day, using Q2 financials or a quick Q3 summary. It then amends later with full Q3 figures to build a longer period of public scrutiny before the roadshow.

(f) I start from a base rate of about 20% for filing roughly 24 or more days before the roadshow. I lower it because the delay was explicitly about Q3 results, because of the staleness constraint and because Anthropic keeps slipping its dates. I make only a small upward adjustment for the investor day timing. I could not see the related Manifold market's price, so I have no market to anchor on.

Probability: 12%
